relation_rows: saved seed and degree-2/3 Hecke relations internal to each selected column set
subset_law: retain the anchored generator column, then the first table_size-1 other original columns under SHA-256 of ASCII 'hecke-shift-density/v1:' plus seed label plus ':' plus decimal original column index
shift_rule: include every checked Q+G edge internal to the selected table and contract each connected shift component
rank_rule: compute exact GF(4021) rank of retained Hecke rows on shift components plus anchored generator row; record residual nullity and number of zero-incidence components
validation: recompute every cell's component graph and quotient rank with Sage GF(4021), and replay saved logs and point identities
